easy: Meant to make people excited, upset, or ready to argue.

ex.en: Her provocative question started a big debate in our class.
ex.ko: 그녀의 도발적인 질문이 우리 반에서 큰 토론을 일으켰다.

easy: Showing what something looks like inside, as if it were cut through.

ex.en: The book showed a sectional view of a volcano.
ex.ko: 그 책에는 화산의 단면도가 실려 있었다.

easy: Taking someone away by force; kidnapping.

ex.en: The police found the boy quickly after his abduction.
ex.ko: 경찰은 유괴된 소년을 금방 찾아냈다.

easy: Telling about or showing the end of the world or a huge disaster.

ex.en: The movie showed an apocalyptic world with empty cities.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 도시가 텅 빈 종말 이후의 세상을 보여 주었다.

easy: Having autism, a condition that makes the brain work differently with talking, feelings, and senses.

ex.en: My autistic cousin knows the name of every kind of train.
ex.ko: 자폐증이 있는 내 사촌은 모든 기차의 이름을 안다.

easy: A person whose job is to carry things.

ex.en: The bearers carried the heavy boxes up the mountain.
ex.ko: 짐꾼들이 무거운 상자를 산 위로 날랐다.

easy: To hurt your body so a dark mark shows under the skin, without cutting it.

ex.en: I bruised my knee when I fell off my bike.
ex.ko: 자전거에서 넘어져서 무릎에 멍이 들었다.

easy: A purple or dark mark on your skin from being hit or bumped.

ex.en: There was a big purple bruise on my arm after the game.
ex.ko: 경기가 끝난 뒤 내 팔에 커다란 보라색 멍이 들어 있었다.

easy: A minister or priest who works for a hospital, school, army, or prison.

ex.en: The hospital chaplain visited the sick children.
ex.ko: 병원 목사님이 아픈 아이들을 찾아갔다.

easy: Mild and pleasant, used about weather.

ex.en: We had clement weather for our camping trip.
ex.ko: 우리가 캠핑 가는 동안 날씨가 온화했다.

easy: A secret agreement between people to do something unfair.

ex.en: The two players were in collusion to cheat at the game.
ex.ko: 두 선수는 게임에서 속임수를 쓰려고 몰래 짜고 있었다.

easy: Having to do with fixing wrong behavior, often in a prison.

ex.en: He works at a correctional center that helps people change their ways.
ex.ko: 그는 사람들이 바르게 살도록 돕는 교정 시설에서 일한다.

easy: To decide that something is true for all, after seeing only a few examples.

ex.en: Don't generalize that all cats are mean just because one scratched you.
ex.ko: 고양이 한 마리가 할퀴었다고 모든 고양이가 못됐다고 일반화하지 마.

easy: A unit for measuring land; it is a square 100 meters long on each side.

ex.en: The farm is about ten hectares in size.
ex.ko: 그 농장의 크기는 약 10헥타르이다.

easy: Against the law or the rules.

ex.en: The general took power in an illegitimate way.
ex.ko: 그 장군은 불법적인 방법으로 권력을 잡았다.

easy: Someone who comes into a place by force to take it over.

ex.en: The thick castle walls kept out the invaders.
ex.ko: 두꺼운 성벽이 침략자들을 막아 주었다.

easy: An old drink made from honey and water.

ex.en: In the old story, the Vikings drank mead from horns.
ex.ko: 옛이야기에서 바이킹들은 뿔잔에 벌꿀 술을 마셨다.

easy: A unit used to measure radio waves and computer speed; one million waves each second.

ex.en: Our favorite radio station plays on 98.7 MHz.
ex.ko: 우리가 좋아하는 라디오 방송은 98.7메가헤르츠에서 나온다.

easy: A "no" vote.

ex.en: The nays won, so we did not get a longer recess.
ex.ko: 반대표가 이겨서 쉬는 시간이 길어지지 않았다.

easy: A person who does wrong things that go against their religion's rules.

ex.en: In the old tale, the sinner never said sorry for what he did.
ex.ko: 옛이야기에서 그 죄인은 자기가 한 일을 끝내 뉘우치지 않았다.

easy: An old word used to speak to a king or an important lord.

ex.en: "Yes, sire," said the knight to the king.
ex.ko: "네, 폐하." 하고 기사가 왕에게 말했다.

easy: To be the father of baby animals, usually horses or dogs.

ex.en: The champion horse sired many fast young horses.
ex.ko: 그 우승마는 빠른 새끼 말을 많이 낳게 했다.

easy: A yellow material found in nature, often near volcanoes; it smells bad when it burns.

ex.en: There was bright yellow sulfur around the volcano's vents.
ex.ko: 화산 분화구 주변에 샛노란 유황이 있었다.

easy: A loud, happy shout.

ex.en: We let out a whoop when our team scored.
ex.ko: 우리 팀이 골을 넣자 우리는 환호성을 질렀다.

easy: To shout loudly because you are happy or excited.

ex.en: The kids whooped when they saw the first snow.
ex.ko: 아이들은 첫눈을 보고 환호성을 질렀다.

easy: A member of a Native American people who lived in what is now Kansas, Oklahoma, and Texas.

ex.en: The Wichita people built round houses out of grass.
ex.ko: 위치타족은 풀로 둥근 집을 지었다.

easy: A person born during the "baby boom," the years after World War II when many babies were born.

ex.en: My grandpa is a boomer who was born in 1955.
ex.ko: 우리 할아버지는 1955년에 태어난 베이비 붐 세대이다.

easy: Coming from Catalonia, a region in northeast Spain, or its people or language.

ex.en: We ate Catalan food when we visited Barcelona.
ex.ko: 우리는 바르셀로나에 갔을 때 카탈루냐 음식을 먹었다.

easy: A person from Catalonia, a region in northeast Spain.

ex.en: My piano teacher is a Catalan from Barcelona.
ex.ko: 우리 피아노 선생님은 바르셀로나 출신의 카탈루냐 사람이다.

easy: A Greek missionary from long ago; the Cyrillic alphabet used for Russian is named after him.

ex.en: The Russian alphabet is named after Saint Cyril.
ex.ko: 러시아 문자는 성 키릴로스의 이름을 따서 지었다.

easy: A loving name you call someone you love very much.

ex.en: "Good night, my dearest," Grandma said.
ex.ko: "잘 자렴, 내 사랑." 하고 할머니가 말씀하셨다.

easy: Something with a certain number of levels or layers, as in "double-decker."

ex.en: We rode a red double-decker bus in London.
ex.ko: 우리는 런던에서 빨간 이층 버스를 탔다.

easy: A famous woman who sings in operas.

ex.en: The diva sang the high note perfectly.
ex.ko: 그 디바는 높은 음을 완벽하게 불렀다.

easy: A person who eats food, often in a certain way.

ex.en: My little brother is a very picky eater.
ex.ko: 내 남동생은 음식을 아주 가려 먹는다.

easy: To change a message into a secret code.

ex.en: The spy encrypted the message so no one else could read it.
ex.ko: 스파이는 아무도 읽지 못하게 메시지를 암호화했다.

easy: A soft material used to fill cracks or holes.

ex.en: Dad used filler to fix the holes in the wall.
ex.ko: 아빠는 메움재로 벽에 난 구멍을 메우셨다.

easy: To have a main office in a certain place.

ex.en: The toy company is headquartered in New York.
ex.ko: 그 장난감 회사는 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있다.

easy: A strong fiber from a plant, used to make rope and cloth.

ex.en: The old rope was made of strong hemp.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 밧줄은 튼튼한 삼으로 만들어졌다.

easy: To get caught on something, or hook something onto it.

ex.en: My sleeve hitched on a nail in the fence.
ex.ko: 내 소매가 울타리 못에 걸렸다.

easy: Something that slows down or stops a process from happening.

ex.en: The medicine is an inhibitor that stops the germs from growing.
ex.ko: 그 약은 세균이 자라지 못하게 막는 억제제이다.

easy: A small, fast falcon with dark feathers.

ex.en: A merlin swooped down to catch a sparrow.
ex.ko: 쇠황조롱이가 참새를 잡으려고 휙 내려왔다.

easy: An old word for the next day.

ex.en: The knight said he would leave on the morrow.
ex.ko: 기사는 이튿날 떠나겠다고 말했다.

easy: The music written by Mozart, a famous composer.

ex.en: My sister plays Mozart on the piano.
ex.ko: 언니는 피아노로 모차르트를 연주한다.

easy: A region on the island of New Guinea, part of the country Papua New Guinea.

ex.en: Papua has thick rainforests full of colorful birds.
ex.ko: 파푸아에는 화려한 새들이 가득한 울창한 열대 우림이 있다.

easy: A mental illness that makes a person wrongly believe others are trying to hurt them.

ex.en: His paranoia made him think everyone was spying on him.
ex.ko: 그는 편집증 때문에 모두가 자기를 감시한다고 생각했다.

easy: To treat people cruelly and unfairly, often because of what they believe.

ex.en: Long ago, some people were persecuted for their religion.
ex.ko: 오래전에 어떤 사람들은 종교 때문에 박해를 받았다.

easy: A chemical that plants need to grow, often found in soil and fertilizer.

ex.en: Plants need phosphate in the soil to grow well.
ex.ko: 식물이 잘 자라려면 흙 속에 인산염이 필요하다.

easy: Being more than one.

ex.en: In English, we often add an "s" to show plurality.
ex.ko: 영어에서는 복수를 나타내려고 흔히 "s"를 붙인다.

easy: The part inside a motor that spins around.

ex.en: The rotor spins fast inside the electric motor.
ex.ko: 전기 모터 안에서 회전자가 빠르게 돈다.

easy: A person who comes up with big ideas to explain how things work.

ex.en: The theorist had a new idea about how the universe began.
ex.ko: 그 이론가는 우주가 어떻게 시작되었는지에 대해 새로운 생각을 내놓았다.

easy: A formal word meaning "in that thing or place."

ex.en: Open the box, and you will find a gift therein.
ex.ko: 상자를 열면 그 안에 선물이 있을 거야.

easy: Living a very simple life without fun or comfort.

ex.en: The monks lived a life of austerity, with no treats or toys.
ex.ko: 수도사들은 간식도 장난감도 없이 금욕적인 삶을 살았다.

easy: The music written by Beethoven, a famous composer.

ex.en: The orchestra played Beethoven at the concert.
ex.ko: 오케스트라가 연주회에서 베토벤을 연주했다.

easy: Computer programs that help people draw exact plans for buildings and machines.

ex.en: My uncle uses CAD to draw plans for new houses.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 캐드로 새 집 설계도를 그린다.

easy: Having to do with the blood tubes that wrap around the heart.

ex.en: Coronary arteries bring blood to the heart muscle.
ex.ko: 관상 동맥은 심장 근육에 피를 보낸다.

easy: A blockage in a blood tube of the heart, which can cause a heart attack.

ex.en: Grandpa had a coronary, but the doctors saved him.
ex.ko: 할아버지가 심장 마비를 일으키셨지만 의사들이 살려 냈다.

easy: A style of design from the 1920s and 1930s with bold shapes and patterns.

ex.en: The old movie theater was built in art deco style.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 영화관은 아르 데코 양식으로 지어졌다.

easy: A group of people chosen to run a company or big organization.

ex.en: The museum's directorate voted to build a new wing.
ex.ko: 박물관 이사회는 새 건물 동을 짓기로 결정했다.

easy: Having something good, like a talent, from birth or as a gift.

ex.en: She is endowed with a beautiful singing voice.
ex.ko: 그녀는 아름다운 노래 목소리를 타고났다.

easy: A clever answer that avoids telling the whole truth.

ex.en: When Mom asked about the cookies, my answer was a clever evasion.
ex.ko: 엄마가 쿠키에 대해 물었을 때 나는 교묘하게 얼버무렸다.

easy: Forcing someone to move out of the place where they live.

ex.en: The family got an eviction notice and had to move.
ex.ko: 그 가족은 퇴거 통지를 받고 이사해야 했다.

easy: A magic spirit from Arabian and Muslim stories.

ex.en: In the story, the genie came out of the lamp and granted three wishes.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 지니가 램프에서 나와 소원 세 가지를 들어주었다.

easy: A thick, sticky, wet substance.

ex.en: The slime kit made green goo that stuck to my hands.
ex.ko: 슬라임 세트로 만든 초록색 끈적이가 손에 달라붙었다.

easy: To put something completely under water or another liquid.

ex.en: Immerse the egg in the dye for five minutes.
ex.ko: 달걀을 염료에 5분 동안 담가 둬.

easy: A narrow flat part sticking out from the side of a cliff or mountain.

ex.en: A goat stood on a narrow ledge high on the mountain.
ex.ko: 염소 한 마리가 산 높은 곳의 좁은 바위 턱에 서 있었다.

easy: A milkshake made with malt powder.

ex.en: I ordered a chocolate malt at the diner.
ex.ko: 나는 식당에서 초콜릿 몰트 셰이크를 주문했다.

easy: Paying close attention to the things you need to do.

ex.en: Her mindfulness about feeding the class fish made the teacher happy.
ex.ko: 그녀가 반 물고기 먹이를 잊지 않고 챙겨서 선생님이 기뻐하셨다.

easy: The study of the shapes and parts of animals and plants.

ex.en: Scientists study the morphology of birds' beaks.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 새 부리의 형태를 연구한다.

easy: Having to do with birth or the place where you were born.

ex.en: Sea turtles return to their natal beach to lay eggs.
ex.ko: 바다거북은 알을 낳으려고 자기가 태어난 해변으로 돌아온다.

easy: Being made a priest or minister in a special ceremony.

ex.en: Many people came to the young priest's ordination.
ex.ko: 많은 사람이 젊은 신부의 서품식에 왔다.

easy: A handgun with a part that turns, usually holding six bullets.

ex.en: The cowboy in the old movie carried a revolver.
ex.ko: 옛날 영화 속 카우보이는 연발 권총을 차고 다녔다.

easy: About the real, important parts of something.

ex.en: We had a substantive talk about how to fix the problem.
ex.ko: 우리는 문제를 어떻게 해결할지 실질적인 이야기를 나누었다.

easy: The scroll with the first five books of the Hebrew Bible, used in Jewish worship.

ex.en: The rabbi read from the Torah scroll.
ex.ko: 랍비가 토라 두루마리를 읽었다.

easy: Having to do with Troy, an ancient city, or its people.

ex.en: The Greeks built a giant wooden horse to get past the Trojan walls.
ex.ko: 그리스인들은 트로이 성벽을 넘으려고 거대한 목마를 만들었다.

easy: A person from the ancient city of Troy.

ex.en: The Trojans pulled the wooden horse into their city.
ex.ko: 트로이 사람들은 목마를 도시 안으로 끌어들였다.

easy: A ruler or leader in some Arab or Muslim lands.

ex.en: The amir ruled a land of deserts and oases.
ex.ko: 그 에미르는 사막과 오아시스의 땅을 다스렸다.

easy: A player who is batting.

ex.en: The batsman hit the ball over the fence.
ex.ko: 타자가 공을 담장 너머로 쳤다.

easy: Giving someone money or gifts to get them to do something wrong or unfair.

ex.en: The judge went to jail for bribery.
ex.ko: 그 판사는 뇌물을 받아 감옥에 갔다.

easy: Having dark brown hair.

ex.en: My brunette cousin has brown hair just like her mom.
ex.ko: 흑갈색 머리인 내 사촌은 엄마처럼 갈색 머리이다.

easy: A person, usually a woman or girl, with dark brown hair.

ex.en: Two blondes and a brunette sat on the bench.
ex.ko: 금발 두 명과 흑갈색 머리 한 명이 벤치에 앉아 있었다.

easy: A group of friends or followers who stick together.

ex.en: The bully walked in with his cohort of friends.
ex.ko: 그 골목대장은 자기 무리와 함께 들어왔다.

easy: An order or rule that must be followed, especially from God.

ex.en: Moses brought the Ten Commandments down the mountain.
ex.ko: 모세는 십계명을 가지고 산에서 내려왔다.

easy: To change from a gas into tiny drops of liquid.

ex.en: Water condenses on the outside of a cold glass of lemonade.
ex.ko: 차가운 레모네이드 잔 겉면에 물방울이 맺힌다.

easy: To come together for a meeting.

ex.en: The student council convened after lunch.
ex.ko: 학생회가 점심시간 뒤에 모였다.

easy: When tiny bits of something spread from where there are many to where there are few.

ex.en: Diffusion makes the smell of cookies spread through the house.
ex.ko: 확산 때문에 쿠키 냄새가 온 집 안에 퍼진다.

easy: Coming from deep in your heart; very sincere.

ex.en: She wrote a heartfelt thank-you card to her teacher.
ex.ko: 그녀는 선생님께 진심 어린 감사 카드를 썼다.

easy: Joining things together into one.

ex.en: The incorporation of new games made recess more fun.
ex.ko: 새로운 놀이를 넣었더니 쉬는 시간이 더 재미있어졌다.

easy: Making something allowed by law.

ex.en: Our town voted on the legalization of fireworks.
ex.ko: 우리 마을은 불꽃놀이 합법화를 두고 투표했다.

easy: To find exactly where something is or where it comes from.

ex.en: The doctor localized the pain to my left knee.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 통증이 왼쪽 무릎에서 오는 것을 알아냈다.

easy: A grass plant whose grains are used to make oatmeal and to feed horses.

ex.en: We eat oatmeal made from oats for breakfast.
ex.ko: 우리는 아침으로 귀리로 만든 오트밀을 먹는다.

easy: To hear what people are saying when they don't know you are listening.

ex.en: I overheard Mom planning my surprise birthday party.
ex.ko: 나는 엄마가 내 깜짝 생일 파티를 계획하는 것을 우연히 들었다.

easy: A small number of things spread out here and there.

ex.en: Only a scattering of people came to the beach in the rain.
ex.ko: 비가 와서 해변에는 몇 사람만 드문드문 있었다.

easy: Doubt about whether something is true.

ex.en: Dad listened with skepticism when I said I had cleaned my room.
ex.ko: 내가 방을 치웠다고 하자 아빠는 미심쩍은 표정으로 들으셨다.

easy: To send someone away from a place and tell them never to come back.

ex.en: The king banished the wicked wizard from the land.
ex.ko: 왕은 사악한 마법사를 나라에서 쫓아냈다.

easy: To give someone an honor or a gift.

ex.en: The queen bestowed a medal on the brave knight.
ex.ko: 여왕은 용감한 기사에게 훈장을 수여했다.

easy: A chemical made with chlorine; table salt is one kind.

ex.en: Table salt is made of sodium chloride.
ex.ko: 식탁용 소금은 염화나트륨으로 되어 있다.

easy: In a way that has to do with doctors treating and testing real patients.

ex.en: The new medicine was clinically tested on many people.
ex.ko: 새 약은 많은 사람을 대상으로 임상 시험을 거쳤다.

easy: A number placed in front of a letter in math to multiply it.

ex.en: In 3x, the number 3 is the coefficient.
ex.ko: 3x에서 숫자 3이 계수이다.

easy: The US government agency that fights the selling of illegal drugs.

ex.en: DEA agents work to stop people from selling illegal drugs.
ex.ko: 미국 마약 단속국 요원들은 불법 마약 판매를 막는 일을 한다.

easy: A church member who helps the minister.

ex.en: The deacon helped the pastor hand out food to families.
ex.ko: 집사님이 목사님을 도와 가족들에게 음식을 나눠 주었다.

easy: A person who is kept locked up, often without a trial.

ex.en: The detainees were held at the police station overnight.
ex.ko: 구금자들은 밤새 경찰서에 붙잡혀 있었다.

easy: Very strong coffee made by pushing hot water through finely ground beans.

ex.en: Dad drinks a tiny cup of espresso every morning.
ex.ko: 아빠는 매일 아침 작은 잔에 에스프레소를 드신다.

easy: A big robbery.

ex.en: The movie is about a clever bank heist.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 교묘한 은행 강도 사건에 관한 이야기이다.

easy: A strong walled fort in the center of an old Russian town.

ex.en: Many old Russian towns have a kremlin with thick walls.
ex.ko: 러시아의 오래된 도시에는 두꺼운 벽으로 둘러싸인 성채가 많다.

easy: A member of a people who live mainly in Malaysia and nearby lands.

ex.en: Many Malays live in Malaysia and Singapore.
ex.ko: 많은 말레이인이 말레이시아와 싱가포르에 산다.

easy: Having to do with the people or language of Malaysia and nearby lands.

ex.en: We ate a spicy Malay dish called nasi lemak.
ex.ko: 우리는 나시 르막이라는 매운 말레이 요리를 먹었다.

easy: A French word used before a man's name, like "Mr."

ex.en: "Bonjour, Monsieur Dupont," said the girl.
ex.ko: "안녕하세요, 뒤퐁 씨." 하고 소녀가 말했다.

easy: A change that happens when something joins with oxygen, like iron turning to rust.

ex.en: The rust on my old bike is caused by oxidation.
ex.ko: 내 낡은 자전거의 녹은 산화 때문에 생긴 것이다.

easy: An archangel, a powerful angel, in Jewish and Christian stories.

ex.en: In old paintings, the archangel Raphael often has big wings.
ex.ko: 옛 그림에서 대천사 라파엘은 흔히 커다란 날개를 달고 있다.

easy: To fix up a place and make it look new and pretty again.

ex.en: We refurbished my room with new paint and curtains.
ex.ko: 우리는 새 페인트와 커튼으로 내 방을 새로 꾸몄다.

easy: An effect that comes later from something you did.

ex.en: Skipping breakfast had repercussions: I was hungry all morning.
ex.ko: 아침을 거른 탓에 나는 오전 내내 배가 고팠다.

easy: A room with toilets that anyone can use in a public place.

ex.en: "Excuse me, where is the restroom?" I asked the waiter.
ex.ko: "실례지만 화장실이 어디예요?" 하고 나는 종업원에게 물었다.

easy: The money used in Sri Lanka.

ex.en: The postcard cost fifty rupees in Sri Lanka.
ex.ko: 스리랑카에서 그 엽서는 50루피였다.

easy: Happening in your mind without you really noticing it.

ex.en: Biting your nails can be a subconscious habit.
ex.ko: 손톱을 깨무는 것은 자기도 모르는 습관일 수 있다.

easy: The part of your mind that works without you noticing it.

ex.en: Some people think dreams come from your subconscious.
ex.ko: 어떤 사람들은 꿈이 잠재의식에서 나온다고 생각한다.

easy: A river, canal, or other water that boats can travel on.

ex.en: Boats carry goods along the waterway.
ex.ko: 배들이 수로를 따라 물건을 실어 나른다.

easy: A written statement that a person swears is true.

ex.en: The witness signed an affidavit saying she saw the accident.
ex.ko: 목격자는 사고를 보았다는 선서 진술서에 서명했다.

easy: A noblewoman with the rank of baron, or the wife of a baron.

ex.en: The baroness lived in a big house on the hill.
ex.ko: 남작 부인은 언덕 위 큰 저택에 살았다.

easy: Plants and animal waste that can be burned or used to make energy.

ex.en: The farm burns biomass like old corn stalks to make energy.
ex.ko: 그 농장은 옥수숫대 같은 바이오매스를 태워 에너지를 만든다.

easy: To stop people from seeing or reading something, like a movie or newspaper.

ex.en: The government censored the newspaper so people could not read the news.
ex.ko: 정부는 사람들이 소식을 읽지 못하게 신문을 검열했다.

easy: To talk together to decide something.

ex.en: The coaches conferred before the last play.
ex.ko: 코치들은 마지막 작전 전에 서로 상의했다.

easy: Saying false things that hurt someone's good name.

ex.en: Telling lies about someone online can be defamation.
ex.ko: 인터넷에 남에 대한 거짓말을 쓰는 것은 명예 훼손이 될 수 있다.

easy: A mark (") that means the same word as the one above is repeated.

ex.en: On my list, I put a ditto mark instead of writing "apples" again.
ex.ko: 나는 목록에 "사과"를 또 쓰는 대신 같음 표시를 했다.

easy: To say or do the same thing again.

ex.en: Max dittoed everything his big brother said.
ex.ko: 맥스는 형이 하는 말을 모두 똑같이 따라 했다.

easy: A person born between late May and late June, under the star sign of the Twins.

ex.en: My sister was born in June, so she is a Gemini.
ex.ko: 언니는 6월에 태어나서 쌍둥이자리이다.

easy: A tax added to the price of things you buy in some countries, like Canada.

ex.en: In Canada, you pay GST when you buy toys.
ex.ko: 캐나다에서는 장난감을 살 때 상품 서비스세를 낸다.
